title: Well made and a nice size for vegetables on the grill
text:
Well made and a nice size for vegetables on the grill. This is a nice size for vegetables. It's well made and won't rust. Washes easily, but not in the dishwasher.
Can be used as a serving tray or for grilling.

product_metadata.title: Wilton Armetale Gourmet Grillware Square Serving Bowl, 1.25-Quart
features: Perfect for the grilling enthusiast, this piece allows you to cook your entire meal on the grill, then serve using the same piece
Armetale metal is 100% recycled, food-safe, aluminum-based alloy metal, this piece will not rust, break, crack, or chip under normal usage - no need to polish
Great for those slip-through-the-grates foods like, peppers and onions, nachos, potatoes, mushrooms and more
Hand wash with mild soap and hot water; towel dry. Do not use in automatic dishwasher
Measures 10-inch long by 10-inch wide by 2.75 -inch high; 2-quart capacity
description: Formal to casual, stylish to rustic, each piece we craft is designed to capture the spirit of your life.
